_readme: Only figures that are known are here. Pallet net weight is bags per pallet
times bag weight, so it is arithmetic - and so it is NOT stored here. It
was, as a single `pallet_net_lb`, and one figure cannot describe two pack
formats: the trade column on the ordering page reported a 50 lb bag pallet
as 1,200 lb when 40 x 50 lb is 2,000 lb. The build derives it per format
now, and cross-checks the result against products.json packs[].pallet_lb.
Pallet height, pallet gross weight and case pack were guesses and have
been removed rather than guessed again: an unmeasured figure on a trade
page is read as a measured one. Add them back when someone has weighed and
measured a built pallet, and add their rows back to

opening_order.mixed_pallet: Any combination of the three grades in retail bags on one pallet, in full layers per grade
opening_order.terms: Set with the account when it is opened, by AragoCor Minerals.
opening_order.lead_time: Confirmed when the order is written.
opening_order.freight: Quoted per order, from Stockton, California.

_dealer_inquiry_endpoint: A URL that accepts a JSON POST of the dealer inquiry. Null means there is
none, and the form composes an email in the visitor's mail client instead:
the submit button then reads 'Compose email' and the confirmation says the
message is drafted rather than sent, because nothing was captured.
Set this to a real endpoint and the same form posts to it, the button reads
'Send inquiry' and the confirmation says the inquiry is on its way. That is
the only change needed; the build wires the rest.
